metadata.title: ETH Lima Hackathon 2026 — Build the Decentralized Future
metadata.description: The premier Web3 hybrid hackathon in Latin America. July 2026, Lima & Virtual. $15,000+ in prizes, expert mentorship, and global networking.
metadata.keywords: Ethereum, Hackathon, Lima, Peru, Web3, Blockchain, Arbitrum, Solidity, Crypto

banner.title: Ethereum Lima Bootcamp, Learn about Arbitrum

hero.description: The premier Web3 hybrid hackathon in Latin America. The hackathon runs July 31 – August 12. Join top developers to build on Arbitrum and scale the decentralized web.

about.title: Elevating the LATAM
about.description: Ethereum Lima 2026 is more than a hackathon; it is a convergence of brilliant minds, protocols, and ideas aimed at solving real-world problems using decentralized technologies.

first.name: Ocean Sense Network
first.desc: A DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network) that democratizes ocean monitoring on the Peruvian coast using IoT buoys operated by artisanal fishermen.

second.name: Colectiva
second.desc: Colectiva groups merchants to buy directly from wholesalers. You get previously impossible prices, your investment is protected, and everyone decides together. Real and smart savings.

first.name: Semilla Microlending
first.desc: Decentralized micro-lending platform that allows communities, NGOs, and businesses to create their own loan funds.

second.name: Turi
second.desc: A platform that rewards tourists based on their reputation gained from visiting tourist sites in Peru and LATAM.

arbitrum-track.description: Build the decentralized future with Arbitrum's scaling solutions.

formation.description: Whether you're new to Web3 or building advanced smart contracts, here you'll find the path to build on Arbitrum. Follow the levels in order or jump to the one that matches your experience.

levels.goal: Understand what a Layer 2 is and take your first steps as a user without touching code.

resources.title: Official Intro to Arbitrum
resources.description: A friendly guide explaining why Ethereum needs scalability solutions and how Arbitrum solves it.

resources.title: Arbitrum Bridge Tutorial
resources.description: Step-by-step guide to connect your wallet and transfer funds from Ethereum safely.

resources.title: Arbitrum Portal
resources.description: Official catalog to discover verified apps, games, and tools active on the network.

levels.goal: Learn to use the network's DeFi protocols and interpret on-chain activity and security data.

resources.title: Layer3 — Interactive Quests
resources.description: Gamified tutorials focused on Arbitrum where you perform real actions on the blockchain.

resources.title: L2BEAT — Security Dashboard
resources.description: Industry reference for auditing an L2's security, reviewing its risks, and verifying TVL.

resources.title: Arbiscan — Block Explorer
resources.description: Track the status of your transactions, wallet balances, and exact gas costs directly on the network.

levels.goal: Program your first smart contracts with Solidity in the Ethereum-compatible environment (EVM).

resources.title: Solidity Quickstart (Remix)
resources.description: Official from-scratch tutorial to compile and deploy your first smart contract using Remix.

resources.title: Foundry on Arbitrum
resources.description: Commands and structure to create, compile, and verify an ERC-20 token contract using Foundry.

levels.goal: Push efficiency to the limit by programming smart contracts in Rust compiled to WebAssembly with Stylus.

resources.title: Stylus Rust Quickstart
resources.description: From installing cargo-stylus to compiling your WASM code and deploying it on the network.

resources.title: Stylus Rust SDK Reference
resources.description: Master storage handling and gas optimization in Rust to get maximum performance out of Stylus.

bootcamp.description: Explore the sessions from our 2025 Bootcamp to learn everything about Arbitrum, from fundamentals to Smart Contracts and Frontend development.
